mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_knowledge_base (question, answer, sql_example, category, quality_score, usage_count, created_at) VALUES (#{question}, #{answer}, #{sqlExample}, #{category}, #{qualityScore}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT k.id, k.question, k.answer, k.sql_example, k.category, k.quality_score, k.usage_count, MATCH(k.question) AGAINST(#{question} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) as relevance, COALESCE(avg_feedback.rating, 3.0) as avg_rating FROM rag_knowledge_base k LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_id, AVG(rating) as rating FROM rag_feedback WHERE rating >= 4 GROUP BY knowledge_id ) avg_feedback ON k.id = avg_feedback.knowledge_id WHERE MATCH(k.question) AGAINST(#{question} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AND k.quality_score >= #{threshold} ORDER BY (relevance * 0.6 + (avg_rating / 5.0) * 0.4) DESC, k.quality_score DESC LIMIT #{maxResults}
SELECT category, COUNT(*) as count FROM rag_knowledge_base GROUP BY category
SELECT id, question, answer, sql_example, category, quality_score, usage_count, created_at FROM rag_knowledge_base ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, question, answer, sql_example, category, quality_score, usage_count, created_at FROM rag_knowledge_base WHERE quality_score < #{threshold} ORDER BY quality_score ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET usage_count = usage_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET quality_score = #{score} WHERE id = #{id}
